evals.prompt: Add Simplified Chinese for the `support_case` object: its label and plural, the `status` field with options New / Open / Closed, the `close` action, and a welcome message that greets the user by name.
evals.expected_output: A `TranslationData` per locale under `objects.support_case` — `label`, `pluralLabel`, `fields.status.label`, `fields.status.options` keyed by the STORED option value (`new`, `open`, `closed`, never the display label), `_actions.close.label` — assembled with `defineTranslationBundle({ en, 'zh-CN': zhCN })` and registered under `defineStack({ translations })`. The message uses double-brace interpolation, `'welcome.user': '欢迎，{{userName}}！'`; there is no ICU plural/select.

evals.prompt: We are adding Japanese to the app.
evals.expected_output: Adds `'ja-JP'` (BCP-47) to `i18n.supportedLocales`, keeps `defaultLocale` / `fallbackLocale`, scaffolds the skeleton with `os i18n extract --locales=ja-JP --out=./src/translations`, adds the `'ja-JP'` key to the bundle, and verifies with `os i18n check --locales=ja-JP`.

evals.prompt: A customer admin wants to relabel `account` as 客户 in their Studio without waiting for a redeploy.
evals.expected_output: A `translation` metadata item (author with `defineTranslation`, shape `TranslationItemSchema`) carrying `locale: 'zh-CN'` and the same `objects.account.label` group as a file bundle; published items layer over the shipped bundles at boot and on every publish, and deleting the item restores the shipped value. One locale per item; the retired `o.*` dialect is rejected on this door too.

evals.prompt: Our storage plugin ships its own generated `objects` translations for `en` and `zh-CN`. Wire them in.
evals.expected_output: Wraps the generated subtree into a `TranslationData` (`{ objects: enObjects }`), builds the bundle with `defineTranslationBundle`, and wraps the translated locale with `withSourceFallback(..., enSource, undefined, zhCNGeneratedSourceHashes)` so a leaf whose source moved is not served forever under a green check. A plugin that owns its objects loads it from its own `kernel:ready` hook via `i18n.loadTranslations(locale, data)` (deep-merge) rather than the stack.

evals.prompt: `os i18n check` reports zh-CN is missing app, navigation and dashboard keys even though we just ran `os i18n extract`. What is wrong?
evals.expected_output: Diagnoses that `--objects-only` is on by default, so extract wrote only the `objects` / `globalActions` subtree while check also demands `apps`, `navigation`, `dashboard`, `widget`, `page` and `flow` keys. Re-runs `os i18n extract --no-objects-only` (or hand-authors those groups), re-checks with `os i18n check --locales=zh-CN`, and adds `--strict` / `--threshold` in CI; `extract --check` is the separate freshness gate.
